answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) relies on Member Lending Institutions to extend assistance to non-corporate micro-enterprises [E01]. The scheme facilitates micro credit/loans up to Rs. 20 lakhs to income generating micro enterprises engaged in the non-farm sector, and the loans are availed through eligible Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) which include public sector banks, private sector banks, cooperative banks, rural banks, micro finance institutions, non-banking finance companies, small finance banks, and other approved financial intermediaries [E01].
